$comment: Schema for pitfall records. This file IS the definition: validate-pitfalls.mjs reads it
and drives every shape, enum and pattern check from here. Only the conditional rules are
code, and each of those carries a rule id that is listed under "rules" below.
Files beginning with _ are not records and are skipped by the validator.
One record per file. The file name must be <id>.json.
$comment_unrecorded: Every environment field may hold the literal string "unrecorded". That is deliberate:
a measurement whose environment was never written down is still a measurement.
Never put a guessed value there. "unrecorded" is the honest answer.
measured_on is NOT one of those fields. A measurement with no date cannot be aged, and a
record that cannot be aged cannot be re-checked when the thing it measured moves under it.
If the date is genuinely unknown, the record is not a measurement -- lower the confidence.

environment.$comment: All five are required whenever the environment object exists. Value or "unrecorded".

$comment: What an external linter can check. required-when-checkable applies when checkable is true.
expect carries the polarity, and without it the pattern is unusable: "grammar === 'shell'"
must be present in the hook, "PowerShell(sc:" must be absent from settings.json, and a
reader cannot tell those apart from the pattern alone.
The word "measured" may only appear in prose that belongs to a measured record.
title is deliberately out of scope: a title quoting a doc heading should not be policed.
claim_gate.pattern: 実測|測定した|検証済み|確認済み|measured

$comment: <repo-relative path>#<heading anchor>. Never a line number: line numbers rot silently.
The anchor is the GitHub-style slug of a heading that must exist in that file.
Derived at index build time. Never stored in a record.
A permissions or hook finding measured against an unknown Claude Code version cannot be
assumed to still hold: the thing being measured is Claude Code itself.

values.unknown_version: measured against a Claude Code version that was never recorded
values.ok: environment is recorded, or the layer does not depend on the Claude Code version
values.not_applicable: the record is not a measurement, so there is no environment to age

rules.what: no missing required fields, no unknown fields
types and enum values are valid
confidence==measured <=> measured_on, environment and repro are all present
environment holds exactly the five fields, each a value or "unrecorded"
confidence==documented requires a non-empty sources list
confidence==inferred requires a non-empty inferred_from list
kind==behaviour forbids status; kind trap|limitation requires it
status==closed requires fix; status==open_recorded requires why_not_closed
claim gate: measurement words only on a measured record
the origin file exists and the origin is not a line number
the origin anchor matches a heading that exists in that file
measured_on is a real date (YYYY-MM-DD). "unrecorded" is not accepted
the file parses as JSON and holds a JSON object
an id is unique across every record set
